title: Good Friday 2025: Here's what is open and closed in the USA
summary: Good Friday is not a federal holiday in the United States, so many public offices and businesses remain open. Observance and hours vary by state, institution and employer: schools and state courts may close, retail and restaurants usually stay open, and some financial markets or private banks may observe limited hours. Travelers and residents should check local schedules and service providers for specific closures and modified hours.
content:
Good Friday 2025 falls on a day when observance across the United States varies widely. Unlike federal holidays such as Independence Day or Thanksgiving, Good Friday is not a nationwide federal holiday, so many federal offices remain open. However, state and local governments, school districts, courts, and private employers may treat the day differently depending on local custom and institutional policy.

What is commonly open: Retail stores, shopping centers and most restaurants generally remain open on Good Friday, often with normal hours. Grocery stores and pharmacies typically operate as usual, though individual chains or local branches may adjust hours in communities with stronger religious observance. Public transit systems generally run, but riders should check for weekend or holiday schedules that may be in effect.

What may be closed or on a reduced schedule: Some state and local courts close or operate on limited hours for religious observance. School closures are common in districts with larger observant communities, so families should check local school calendars. Certain municipal offices and services may operate on a reduced schedule; it is best to confirm with city or county websites.

Financial services and markets: Good Friday is not a federal bank holiday, so many banks remain open; nevertheless, some private banks and regional branches may choose to close or reduce hours. Historically, U.S. stock exchanges have sometimes observed Good Friday, so investors should verify whether markets like the NYSE or NASDAQ will be open or closed on the specific date.

Travel and transportation: Air travel typically continues as scheduled, but travelers should monitor airline notices for any schedule adjustments. Intercity bus and rail services commonly operate but may follow weekend timetables. When planning trips, confirm reservations and check for any local observances that could affect transportation hubs.

Practical tips: Confirm hours for critical services such as pharmacies, banks and healthcare providers before you go. If you need government or court services, consult the appropriate local or state website. For those planning to shop or dine out, call ahead to ensure normal operations. When in doubt, local government and major service providers post holiday hours online well in advance of the date.

In summary, Good Friday in the USA is a patchwork of observance: many businesses and services remain open, while others may close or run reduced hours depending on local practices. Check locally for the most accurate information and plan accordingly.
